rationale: No Tool Shed wrapper runs a paired-end or single-end layout decision over BAM or CRAM records. Seven name variants were searched ('paired end', 'single end paired end', 'check paired', 'paired reads', 'bam paired', 'samtools view paired flag', 'checkpairedend'). The nearest hits run other operations: samtools_flag_filter (filters alignments by flag; outputs a BAM, not a per-element boolean), samtools_view (generic), pairedbamtobed12 (converts pairs to bed12), split_paired_reads and get_pairs (act on FASTQ), so none is a classifier. A miss is recorded; the caller falls through to author-galaxy-tool-wrapper.
